## **Bugs and stability** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs and stability.**
      12 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: Apr 20, 2026 - Nov 9, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _hangintheredad_, Nov 9, 2026, 1/5: "I actually quite like this app and feel bad giving a low rating, but I can't find out how to simply submit a bug report, and the Support Bot in the app doesn't know either. So here goes - when using the iOS app, I frequently encounter a bug where the text caret becomes out-of-sync with where the typing is actually occurring. The blinking line will pop up randomly on the page and it becomes difficult to keep track of what's happening. If I exit the app & restart it, the problem fixes itself, but only for a short amount of time until it inevitably happens again. I tried to use the Support Bot to report this, and it offered to submit a bug report on my behalf... and then said that it actually did not have that capability, which was frustrating. The directions it then gave for me to submit my own report seemed to be both hallucination / for other weird Beta versions of the app I did not even know existed. Did we have to go all-in on this clunky AI, fellas?"
            2. _BlA387532_, Sep 24, 2026, 1/5: "The amount of times it glitches is absolutely uncanny. And that for 700€+ per year. Currently looking for an alternative."
            3. _AS-QV_, Aug 13, 2026, 1/5: "Lot of bugs like emoji selection failures, Formatting text on the phone. Notion used to be the minimalist note taking app with seamless UX. Now, it's like any other tech company. Product is pushing to add more features for the cost of reduced usability to boost internal KPIs. Save Notion or I'm out to Obsidian!"
<!--/ir-theme-->
